scope: VMD sizing plan audit and independent read-only code review
reviewer: sizing_code_review subagent; findings cross-checked by parent

open: 12.3 native MCP/UI synchronization and lifecycle validation

findings.title: Selecting a new target overwrites the queued member before Add
findings.trigger: Queue A, select B, then Add. MarkDirty rewrites A to B, so Add finds B already present and cannot append it.
findings.impact: Normal UI cannot build a multi-character queue; existing member is silently replaced.
findings.validation: Source control-flow review, not a new C4D interaction run.

findings.title: Removing a member leaves editor fields bound to the removed member
findings.trigger: With A/B queued, select and remove B. RefreshQueue selects A without LoadEntry. Calculate uses A while fields show B; a parameter edit overwrites A with B.
findings.impact: Displayed inputs differ from calculation inputs and remaining member configuration can be overwritten.
findings.validation: Source control-flow review, not a new C4D interaction run.

recommended_followup: Fix queue input identity and selection/editor synchronization
Validate add/remove/edit scenarios in the loaded synchronization build
Complete menu peer-entry acceptance and update plan receipts
